claims.quote: Calcium deficiency (which is common) and phosphate deficiency should be corrected.
claims.locator: Treatment of Vitamin D Deficiency and Dependency

claims.text: Uncomplicated rickets (adequate Ca and phosphate intake): vitamin D3 40 mcg (1600 IU) orally once a day;
claims.quote: As long as calcium and phosphate intake is adequate, adults with osteomalacia and children with uncomplicated rickets can be cured by giving vitamin D3 40 mcg (1600 international units [IU]) orally once a day.
claims.locator: Treatment of Vitamin D Deficiency and Dependency

claims.text: after about 1 mo, reduce to the usual maintenance of 15 mcg (600 IU) once/day.
claims.quote: After approximately 1 month, the dose can usually be reduced gradually to the usual maintenance level of 15 mcg (600 IU) once/day.
claims.locator: Treatment of Vitamin D Deficiency and Dependency

claims.text: Tetany: add IV calcium salts for up to 1 wk.
claims.quote: If tetany is present, vitamin D should be supplemented with IV calcium salts for up to 1 week
claims.locator: Treatment of Vitamin D Deficiency and Dependency
